newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine soybeans steady, grains and sunseed firm.
newsitem.headline: Argentine soybeans steady, grains and sunseed firm.

text.p: Argentine cash soybean prices were steady Tuesday on the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange in line with the bounce in Chicago, where they fell Monday when Argentine markets were closed for a bank holiday.
Cash maize was $1 a tonne firmer in moderate volume as renewed interest from exporters met scant interest from sellers. Wheat was also about $1 higher with sellers scarce.
Cash sunseed strengthened about $2 a tonne on demand from millers and interest in oil from abroad.
